ui.why: Why Sanur villa owners call me
why_items: Not a call centre and not a crew. The person you message is the person who does the job.
I don't cross the island. I know Sanur villas: old pools, brackish wells near the beach, rooftop tanks.
Abroad? You get before-and-after photos and a short list of what was done.
ui.master_txt: A photo and a few words about the technician go here: name, years of experience, languages. In Bali people choose a person, not a company.

ui.local_intro: Most call-outs in Sanur come down to the same local conditions. Knowing them is half the diagnosis — that's why I work in one area only.
local_items: A lot of Sanur villas still run on their original PVC pipework and fittings. Pipes that sit in the sun turn brittle, and joints start to weep. Often it's smarter to replace a section than to patch it again.
In Sindhu, Semawang and Mertasari the sea air eats into taps, shower heads, hinges and pump motors much faster than inland. Choosing the right materials saves repeat repairs.
Many villas combine PDAM mains with a well. Close to the sea, well water can be brackish — filters and cartridges clog faster and heaters build scale.
Water pressure depends on the tank, the pump and the pressure switch. Most 'weak shower' and 'pump keeps switching on' calls start here, not in the tap.
Septic tanks are small and pipes are narrow. Blockages and smells usually mean paper or grease in the system, or a tank that is overdue for pumping.
Roughly November to March heavy rain tests roofs, gutters, drains, pools and septic tanks. The best time for checks is before the first big storms.
ui.hoods_txt: I work across all of Sanur: Sanur Kaja, Sanur Kauh, Sindhu, Semawang, Mertasari and Batujimbar — along Jl. Danau Tamblingan, Jl. Danau Poso and the Bypass Ngurah Rai. Villas, houses, apartments and small guesthouses.
pricing_items: Send photos or a video — you get a price before I come, and we agree it before work starts.
Parts are bought at cost and you get the receipt.
After the job you get before-and-after photos on WhatsApp.
ui.projects_lead: Real jobs in Sanur: what was wrong and what was done.

srv-santehnik.name: Plumber in Sanur
srv-santehnik.intro: A private plumber in Sanur: I come myself, find the cause and fix it. Taps, toilets, pipes, pumps and hot water — in villas, houses and apartments.
faq: How fast can you come?
Depends on the day's schedule. Send a photo on WhatsApp and I'll tell you when I can be there.
Who buys the parts?
Either way. I can buy them and give you the receipt.

srv-protechki.name: Water Leak Repair
srv-protechki.intro: Finding and fixing leaks: under sinks, in walls, showers and garden lines. A hidden leak often shows up on the PDAM meter or a pump that keeps running.
items: Hidden leaks found via the meter
faq: What should I do before you arrive?
Close the main valve and, if water is near sockets, switch off the power.

srv-zasor.name: Blocked Drains & Toilets
srv-zasor.intro: Clearing blocked toilets, sinks, showers and drain lines with a drain snake, without harsh chemicals that damage pipes and septic tanks.
faq: Why no toilet paper in the toilet in Bali?
Narrow pipes and small septic tanks — paper clogs the system quickly.

srv-bojler.name: Water Heater Repair & Installation
srv-bojler.intro: No hot water? I'll find out why — electric heater, gas heater or rooftop solar. Heating elements, thermostats, anodes and new installations.
faq: Repair or replace?
A leaking tank means replace. A failed element or thermostat is usually worth repairing.

srv-voda.name: Water Pumps & Filters
srv-voda.intro: Pumps, pressure switches, rooftop tanks and water filters. Near the beach in Sanur, well water can be brackish — I'll help with filtration or switching to PDAM.
faq: How often to change cartridges?
Usually every 3–6 months depending on the water. I'll show you what to look for.

srv-chistka-bassejna.name: Pool Cleaning
srv-chistka-bassejna.intro: One-off pool cleaning: skimming, brushing, vacuuming, filter backwash and water balance. Green pool recovery.
faq: How long to fix a green pool?
Usually 2–4 days, depending on the water and the filter.

srv-obsluzhivanie-bassejna.name: Regular Pool Service
srv-obsluzhivanie-bassejna.intro: Scheduled pool service. After every visit you get a WhatsApp report: photos, water readings, work done. Ideal if you don't live in Bali full-time.
faq: Are chemicals included?
Agreed upfront: either included or charged separately with receipts.

srv-oborudovanie-bassejna.name: Pool Equipment
srv-oborudovanie-bassejna.intro: Installation and repair of pumps, sand and cartridge filters, chlorinators, lights and auto-fill.
faq: Can I send a photo of the pump room?
Yes — that's the best way for me to know what to bring.

srv-remont-bassejna.name: Pool Repair
srv-remont-bassejna.intro: Leaks, loose tiles, grout, pipework. Many pools in Sanur are 15–20 years old — I'll help decide what to fix first.
faq: Evaporation or a leak?
Bucket test: put a bucket of water on the step and compare both levels after 24 hours.

srv-septik.name: Septic & Sewer
srv-septik.intro: Smells, slow drains, full septic tank. I'll find the problem, arrange pumping and clear the lines.
faq: How often to pump a septic tank?
Depends on size and occupants — typically every 1–3 years.

srv-melkij-remont.name: Handyman
srv-melkij-remont.intro: Small home repairs in one visit: doors, locks, mosquito screens, silicone, shelves, furniture.
faq: Can I list several jobs for one visit?
Yes, that's the best value. Send the list with photos.

srv-obsluzhivanie-villy.name: Villa Maintenance
srv-obsluzhivanie-villy.intro: Regular villa check-ups: plumbing, pool, pumps, water heaters, roof before the rainy season. For owners and managers.
faq: Do you work with villa managers?
Yes, we can set up a regular schedule.
